description: Moves an incoming note off the intervals you have ruled out against a chord, and publishes the notes that are left as a scale

params.text: Lights while this interval is one of the ruled-out ones; the module writes this button every cycle from the harmony and count knobs, so turning it by hand has no lasting effect
Steps through the sets of intervals that can be ruled out at the number set by the count knob
Sets how many intervals are ruled out at once, 1 to 5
Switches whether the notes of the chord itself are allowed through: with it on they are always allowed, and with it off they are ruled out along with the intervals

inputs.text: The note to correct, as a 1V/octave pitch; with nothing patched a random note is taken instead
A rising edge works out a new note and opens the gate output; with nothing patched a new note is worked out every cycle
The chord the intervals are measured against, as a polyphonic 1V/octave pitch
Which channels of the chord count, one channel per chord note and wrapped round when there are fewer; a channel below 0.1V is left out of the chord
Adds to the harmony knob, a tenth of its travel per volt
Adds to the count knob, one interval per volt

outputs.text: The corrected note, as a 1V/octave pitch in the octave the note arrived in
10V while the gate input is high, or steadily while nothing is patched there
10V when the note that arrived had to be moved, 0V when it was let through as it stood
The twelve semitones as twelve channels, each 10V where that semitone is allowed and 0V where it is ruled out
The allowed semitones as 1V/octave pitches, one channel each, so the channel count is the size of the scale

notes: with no chord patched nothing is ruled out and the note arrives at the output unchanged.
the six interval buttons are indicators: they are written from the harmony and count knobs on every pass, so they show what is ruled out rather than setting it.
menu: update cycle — sets how many samples pass between one recalculation and the next, 1 to 1024

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads a random note.
inputs.1:
high above 0.1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads a new note every processed sample.
inputs.3:
high above 0.1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads every chord channel counts.
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
